source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Ohio State University Cooperative Extension, Sandusky County Family Nutrition Program

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 325 °F.
Beat 12 large egg whites in a large mixing bowl until foamy.
Add 1 teaspoon of cream of tartar and beat until stiff, but not dry.
Gradually beat in 1 1/2 cups of sugar.
Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Gently fold in 1 cup of sifted flour.
Pour the batter into a 10-inch tube pan.
Bake for 75 minutes, until the top is nicely browned.
steps.spoken: Bake for 75 minutes, until the top is nicely browned. Bake for an hour and fifteen minutes, or until the top is nicely browned.

ingredients.name: apples, sliced (14 ounces of sliced apples)

steps.instruction: Whisk 1/3 cup of plain low-fat yogurt and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise together.
Whisk in 1 tablespoon of honey and 2 teaspoons of paprika.
Slice 2 ripe bananas.
Place 12 ounces of lettuce mix in a large salad bowl.
Add the bananas, 2 1/2 sliced apples and 3/4 cup of unsalted peanuts.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss.
Wash the cabbage.
Cut the cabbage into fine shreds, until you have 2 cups.
Peel 1 medium carrot.
Grate the carrot with a grater.
Chop 1/2 of a medium green pepper into small pieces.
Remove the core of 1 medium apple, and chop the apple.
Put the cabbage, carrot, green pepper and apple in a large bowl and stir.
Stir 5 tablespoons of yogurt, 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise and 1 teaspoon of lemon juice.
Stir in 1/4 teaspoon of dill weed to make a dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to mix.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Creative Recipes for Less Familiar USDA Commodities Used by Household Programs, USDA, Food and Nutrition Service, Food Distribution Service

steps.instruction: Put 1 medium head of lettuce (about 10 cups) in a large bowl.
Add 2 sliced medium apples and 1/2 cup of chopped walnuts.
Add 1 cup of dried cranberries and 1/2 cup of sliced green onions.
Toss everything together in the bowl.
Add 3/4 cup of vinaigrette dressing.
Toss to coat.
Serve right away.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Go With Chicken, University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service, Eau Claire County

ingredients.name: whole chicken, raw, cut into pieces, skin removed

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Place 4 sliced potatoes, 6 sliced carrots and 1 quartered onion in a roasting pan.
Put the pieces of 1 whole chicken on top of the vegetables.
Mix 1/2 cup of water, 1 teaspoon of thyme and 1/4 teaspoon of ground black pepper.
Pour the water mixture over the chicken and vegetables.
Bake for 1 hour, until browned and tender.
steps.spoken: Bake for 1 hour or more, until the chicken and vegetables are browned and tender.

steps.instruction: Spoon the juices over the chicken once or twice while it bakes.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: The Big Book of Lentils Cookbook, Canadian Lentils

steps.instruction: Add 1/4 cup of red lentils to a small saucepan of boiling water.
steps.spoken: Add 1/4 cup of red lentils to a small saucepan of boiling water. Cook for 15 to twenty minutes, until soft.

steps.instruction: Drain the lentils well.
Stir 1 cup of oats, 1 cup of flour and 1/4 cup of brown sugar in a large bowl.
Stir in 1 teaspoon of cinnamon and 2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Whisk 3/4 cup of yogurt, 3/4 cup of milk and 1/4 cup of oil in a smaller bowl.
Whisk 2 large eggs and 1 teaspoon of vanilla into the yogurt mixture.
Add the yogurt mixture, 2 mashed bananas and the lentils to the dry mix.
Stir until just combined.
Preheat the oven to 250 °F to keep the pancakes warm.
Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat.
Add a drizzle of oil and wipe it around the pan with a paper towel.
Pour about 1/2 cup of batter into the skillet and spread it with the back of a spoon.
steps.spoken: Pour about 1/2 cup of batter into the skillet. If you need to, spread it out with the back of a spoon, because it is thick. Cook for a couple of minutes, until bubbles break through the surface and the bottom is golden.

steps.instruction: Keep the heat at medium so the bottoms do not burn.
steps.spoken: Keep the heat at medium. These take longer to cook through than most pancakes, and you do not want to burn the bottoms.

steps.instruction: Flip the pancake with a thin spatula and cook until golden and springy to the touch.
Keep the pancakes warm on a rack set on a baking sheet in the oven.
Cook the rest of the batter the same way to make 10 pancakes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a pan.
Fry 1 diced onion in the hot ghee until it starts to brown.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of ginger paste and 5 cloves of pounded garlic, and stir.
Add 1 teaspoon of chile powder and 1/2 teaspoon of coriander powder.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of cumin powder and 1/4 teaspoon of turmeric powder.
Blend the spices in well.
Add 5 diced tomatoes and salt to taste.
Cover the pan over medium heat for 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: vanilla sugar or other vanilla flavoring

steps.instruction: Beat 5 eggs until creamy.
Gradually add 1 cup of sugar.
Add 2 packages of vanilla sugar or other vanilla flavoring.
Mix in 9 ounces of melted butter.
Add 2 tablespoons of baking powder.
Alternate adding 1 1/2 cups of milk and 4 cups of flour, stirring constantly.
steps.spoken: Alternate adding 1 1/2 cups of milk and 4 cups of flour, stirring constantly. Add the milk and flour in turns, stirring constantly. The source uses about 1 1/2 to one and three quarter cups of milk.

steps.instruction: Mix on the highest mixer speed until the dough is smooth.
Let the dough rest for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Let the dough rest for 2 minutes. Let the dough rest for a couple of minutes.

steps.instruction: Turn on and preheat your waffle maker.
Pour the dough into the waffle maker.
Bake until golden brown.
Place 1/2 cup of cooked tapioca pearls in a large glass.
Add 1 cup of crushed ice and 1 cup of strong chilled black tea to a shaker.
Add 1 cup of milk, and honey or sugar to taste.
Shake vigorously until the mixture is frothy.
Pour the tea into the glass and serve with large-diameter straws.
Put 1 tablespoon of black tea leaves and 3 cups of whole milk in a pot.
Boil the tea and milk for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil the tea and milk for 2 to ten minutes. Boil longer for stronger tea.

steps.instruction: Strain the tea into cups.
Add 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter and salt to taste.
Stir the tea thoroughly.
steps.spoken: Stir the tea thoroughly. A blender works best, but use it carefully because the tea is hot.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 400 °F.
Cut the squash in half lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Rub the onions and squash with 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Bake the squash and onions uncovered for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Bake the squash and onions uncovered for about 1 hour, until soft when poked with a fork.

steps.instruction: Let the squash and onions cool a little.
Spoon the squash pulp into a food processor.
Add the onions and 1 cup of stock.
steps.spoken: Add the onions and 1 to 2 cups of the chicken or vegetable stock.

steps.instruction: Purée until smooth.
Pour the soup into a cooking pot.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic, 1/4 cup of sherry and 1 teaspoon of nutmeg.
Stir the soup over medium heat.
Add the rest of the stock and cook until hot.
Season to taste.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans

ingredients.name: chicken, boneless, skinless (breast or leg), cubed
green chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped
cold water, for the skillet and to cover the stew

steps.instruction: Spray a heavy iron skillet with cooking spray.
Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Brown 3 pounds of cubed chicken in the skillet, in batches.
steps.spoken: Brown 3 pounds of cubed chicken in the skillet, in batches. Brown the chicken cubes in batches, using more cooking spray as needed.

steps.instruction: Place the chicken in a 3- or 4-quart casserole with a cover.
Add 3 stalks of chopped celery and 1 medium diced tomato to the casserole.
Add 7 chopped green chilies and 4 cloves of crushed garlic.
Add some cold water to the skillet on high heat.
Scrape the hardened juices with a spoon so they dissolve into the water.
Add the sauce from the skillet to the casserole.
Add water to barely cover the ingredients.
Cover the casserole and simmer for 90 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the casserole and simmer for 90 minutes. Cover the casserole and simmer for about an hour and a half, until the stew is thick and the meat is very tender.

steps.instruction: Add black pepper to taste before serving.
Put 1 bottle of ketchup, 1/4 cup of Worcestershire sauce and 1 1/2 cans of cola in a pot.
Add 1/2 cup of soy sauce, 1/4 cup of cider vinegar and hot sauce to taste.
Bring everything to a boil.
Cook over high heat for 10 minutes.
Store the sauce in a nonreactive container in the fridge for up to 1 week.

ingredients.name: wheat flour or guinea corn flour

steps.instruction: Dissolve 1/2 teaspoon of potash in a little water in a small bowl.
Set the potash water aside.
Mix 2 cups of wheat flour with 2 tablespoons of baobab leaf flour in a bowl.
Slowly add the potash water to the flour mix.
Slowly add 1 cup of water, stirring, until the batter is thick and smooth.
steps.spoken: Slowly add 1 cup of water while stirring, until the batter is thick and smooth. Adjust the water as needed.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Drop small scoops of the batter into the boiling water.
steps.spoken: Scoop small portions of the batter with a spoon or your hand and drop them into the boiling water. Let the dumplings cook for 10 to 15 minutes, until they float and feel firm to the touch.

steps.instruction: Drain the dumplings.
Drizzle 3 tablespoons of vegetable oil over the dumplings.
Season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt, or to taste.
Top with 1/2 an onion, chopped, and shredded cabbage or yaji.
Heat the oven to 350 °F.
In a bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups of rolled oats and 1 1/2 cups of all-purpose flour.
Add 1 cup of packed brown sugar, 1 teaspoon of baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Add 1 cup of melted butter and mix until crumbly.
Press half of the crumb mixture into a greased, parchment-lined square baking pan.
Put 2 cups of chopped dates, 1/2 cup of brown sugar and 1 cup of water in a saucepan.
Cook over low heat for 10 minutes, until thick and smooth.
steps.spoken: Cook over low heat for about 10 minutes, until the mixture is thick and smooth.

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of lemon juice and mix well.
Spread the date mixture over the crumb layer.
Sprinkle the rest of the crumb mixture over the date filling.
Bake for 35 minutes, until lightly browned.

ingredients.name: bacon, or mushrooms or other vegetables instead

steps.instruction: Flatten 14 ounces of pizza dough as thin as you can.
steps.spoken: Flatten 14 ounces of pizza dough as thin as you can, about 1/16 inch. Put it between two pieces of parchment paper and press it flat with a bottle. It should fill 2 baking sheets, so you make two large flammkuchen, one per person.

steps.instruction: Put the flat dough on baking trays.
Preheat the oven to 450 °F.
steps.spoken: Preheat the oven to 450 to five hundred °F.

steps.instruction: Spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream over the dough in a very thin layer.
steps.spoken: Spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream or creme fraiche evenly over the dough. It should be a very thin layer that just barely covers the dough.

steps.instruction: Cut 1 onion and 5 ounces of bacon into small pieces.
Spread the onion and bacon evenly over the dough.
Bake for 10 minutes, until the thin parts turn a bit brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 minutes. Take it out when it is getting a bit dark and the thin parts are a bit brown.

steps.instruction: Season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Heat 1/2 cup of water and 1 1/3 cups of sugar until fully dissolved.
Melt 1/2 pound of butter in a large saucepan over low heat.
Add 4 ounces of bittersweet and 8 ounces of unsweetened chocolate.
Whisk until smooth.
Whisk in the sugar syrup.
Let the mixture cool slightly.
Add 5 beaten eggs and whisk until well blended.
Pour the mixture into a greased, parchment-lined 9-inch springform pan.
Wrap the bottom and sides of the pan in aluminum foil.
steps.spoken: Wrap the bottom and sides of the pan in aluminum foil, so no water can seep in while the cake bakes in the water bath.

steps.instruction: Bake the cake in a water bath for 25 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake the cake in a water bath in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Fry 1 chopped onion in a skillet with 1 dash of oil.
steps.spoken: Fry 1 chopped onion in a skillet with 1 dash of oil until the onion is soft and clear.

steps.instruction: Add 2 pounds of ground beef to the onion.
Cook, breaking up the meat, until it is browned.
Put the meat mixture in a large stockpot.
Add 36 ounces of stewed tomatoes, 16 ounces of corn and 8 ounces of peas.
Add 6 chopped celery stalks and 6 cubed potatoes.
Add 8 ounces of beef broth, 8 ounces of chicken broth and 1 cup of rice.
Add 2 tablespoons of salt and 2 tablespoons of pepper.
Add about 2 cups of water, enough to cover everything by a few inches.
Place the pot in a 325 °F oven and bake for 6 hours.
Stir in cooked pasta if using it. Makes 6 quarts.
Boil the diced potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil the diced potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes, to soften them slightly.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes and let them dry.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil or butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add 1/2 small chopped onion, and 1/4 cup of green bell pepper if using.
Sauté until the onion is soft and clear.
Add the potatoes to the pan in a single layer.
steps.spoken: Add the potatoes in a single layer. Let them brown without moving them for 5 to 6 minutes.

steps.instruction: Flip and cook the other sides until golden and crispy.
Season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of paprika.
Add 1/2 cup of water, 1/2 cup of milk and 1 teaspoon of tea leaves to a saucepan.
Add 2 teaspoons of sugar or 1 packet of artificial sweetener.
Add 1 dash of chai masala.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Simmer for 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Simmer for no more than 1 minute, unless you like a stronger tea taste.

steps.instruction: Strain the tea into a cup.
Separate 4 eggs into whites and yolks.
Stir the egg yolks, 1 1/2 cups of flour and 1 1/4 cups of milk in a bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and a pinch of salt, and stir until the clumps are gone.
Beat the egg whites in a different bowl until stiff peaks form.
Add the beaten egg whites to the other bowl.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a flat pan on high heat.
Add the batter to the pan and cook it on both sides.
Put the pan in the oven for 10 minutes, until lightly browned.
steps.spoken: Put the pan in the oven for around 10 minutes, until the top is lightly browned.

steps.instruction: Cut the dough into bite-sized pieces with a spatula.
Sprinkle a little sugar and the raisins on top.
Stir together 1 cup of flour, 2 teaspoons of baking powder and 1 pinch of salt.
steps.spoken: Stir together 1 cup of flour, 2 teaspoons of baking powder and 1 pinch of salt, until light and no longer clumpy.

steps.instruction: Work 2 tablespoons of butter into the flour with your fingertips.
Add 1/2 cup of milk.
Form the dough into 5 balls.
steps.spoken: Form the dough into 5 to six balls.

steps.instruction: Bring 1 cup of water and 1 cup of maple syrup to a simmer in a saucepan with a lid.
Add the dough balls to the simmering syrup.
Cover the pot and simmer on low for 12 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pot and simmer on low for 12 to fifteen minutes.

ingredients.name: heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Add 2 1/2 cups of crumbled cornbread and 1/2 cup of mascarpone cheese to a large bowl.
steps.spoken: Add 2 and a half cups of crumbled cornbread and 1/2 cup of the mascarpone to a large bowl. Keep the other 1/4 cup of mascarpone for later.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper and 1 tablespoon of sage.
Add 4 beaten egg yolks and 1/4 cup of melted butter.
Mix everything together.
Gently fold in 2 cups of heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks.
Put the mixture in a baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

steps.instruction: Spread the remaining 1/4 cup of mascarpone cheese on top.
Put it under a preheated broiler until browned and bubbly.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Gradually stir 4 tablespoons of cold water into 2 1/2 tablespoons of bread flour.
steps.spoken: Gradually stir 4 tablespoons of cold water into 2 1/2 tablespoons of bread flour, until you have a smooth, thin paste.

steps.instruction: Add the paste to 1 pint of scalded milk, stirring until thickened.
Cover the pot and cook for 20 minutes.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of butter in small pieces.
Dip each of the 6 slices of dry toast in the sauce until soft.
Move the soft toast to a serving dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over the toast.
Put 2 egg whites, 1 1/2 cups of sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt in a large bowl.
Add 1 teaspoon of vinegar, 1 teaspoon of cornstarch and 4 tablespoons of boiling water.
Beat until the mixture is smooth, stiff and shiny.
Keep beating for 12 minutes, until soft peaks form.
steps.spoken: Keep beating for about 12 minutes, until soft peaks form when you lift the beater.

steps.instruction: Place the mixture on baking paper on a tray.
Bake in the middle of the oven at 350 °F for 10 minutes.
Lower the oven to 300 °F and bake for 45 minutes.
Turn off the oven and leave the pavlova to cool in the oven.

ingredients.name: red chiles, seeded and finely chopped
turnip, peeled and sliced very thin

steps.instruction: Bring 1/4 cup of water to a boil in a saucepan.
Stir in 1 cup of brown sugar until it dissolves.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add 4 finely chopped large red chiles and 1 pinch of salt.
Take the pan off the heat and let the syrup cool.
Peel and cube or slice 1 mango, 2 sour apples and 1 small pineapple.
Peel and cube or slice 2 large cucumbers and 3 oranges.
Peel 1 turnip and slice it very thin.
Arrange the fruit and vegetables in a bowl.
Pour the syrup over the top.
Put 4 skinless chicken breasts in a small pot.
Add enough water to cover the chicken.
Slice 2 stalks of celery into large sticks.
Add the celery, 2 bay leaves, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 cup of peppercorns.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat and simmer for at least 1 hour. The chicken should be tender and pull apart easily.

steps.instruction: Take the chicken out of the water.
steps.spoken: Take the chicken out of the water. You may want to save the water as a base for a stock or a soup.

steps.instruction: Slice the chicken into small bite-size cubes.
steps.spoken: Slice the chicken into small bite-size cubes. Don't shred it, because the salad should be chunky.

steps.instruction: Put the cut chicken in a medium bowl.
Add 1 cup of mayonnaise and 1 cup of mango chutney, a spoonful at a time.
steps.spoken: Add the mayonnaise and the mango chutney, 1 cup of each, one spoonful at a time, until the salad is moist and chunky, not wet and mushy.

steps.instruction: Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add 1 pound of ground beef to a skillet over medium heat.
Cook the beef until it is browned.
Drain the ground beef.
Return the beef to the skillet, on medium heat.
Mix in 1 packet of taco seasoning and 3 tablespoons of chili powder.
Mix in 3 tablespoons of garlic powder and 8 ounces of tomato sauce.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Heat the oven to 375 °F.
In a casserole dish, mix the beef, 3 torn tortillas and 3 cups of shredded cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes.

ingredients.name: salad oil (olive oil, canola or sunflower)

steps.instruction: Put 1/3 cup of salad oil and 1/2 cup of cider vinegar in a large salad bowl.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper and 1/4 cup of sugar.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of celery seed and whisk until blended.
Empty 1 can each of green beans, waxed beans and kidney beans into a colander.
Rinse the beans under cold water.
Thinly slice 1 carrot, and chop 1 small onion and 1 bell pepper.
Add the carrot, onion and bell pepper to the dressing.
Add the beans and stir gently.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, stirring now and then.

ingredients.name: scallions, green onions, rinsed and sliced
spinach or arugula, rinsed and dried
portabella mushroom, rinsed, grilled or broiled, and sliced, optional

steps.instruction: Preheat the broiler on high, with the rack 3 inches from the heat.
steps.spoken: Preheat the broiler on high, with the rack 3 inches from the heat. Or heat a grill to medium-high.

steps.instruction: Mix 12 ounces of ground turkey, 1/2 cup of scallions, 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and 1 egg.
Form the mixture into 4 patties, 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick.
Coat each patty lightly with 1 tablespoon of olive oil in all.
Broil or grill the burgers for 7 minutes on the first side.
steps.spoken: Broil or grill the burgers for 7 to nine minutes on the first side.

steps.instruction: Turn the burgers and cook 7 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 160 °F.
steps.spoken: Turn the burgers and cook the second side for 7 to nine minutes, until a thermometer reads 160 °F in the middle of the patty.

steps.instruction: Mix 2 tablespoons of light mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon of Dijon mustard into a spread.
Put 3/4 tablespoon of the spread on each bun.
Add 1 ounce of spinach or arugula to each bun.
Add several slices of grilled portabella mushroom to each bun if you like.
Put 1 burger on each bun.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style

ingredients.name: summer squash, cut into 4 large chunks
sweet corn, rinsed and drained (or 2 ears fresh corn)

steps.instruction: Bring 3 cups of water and 1 bouillon cube to a boil in a large pot.
Add 2 cups of potato strips and 2 cups of sliced carrots.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cups of potatoes cut in 2-inch strips and 2 cups of sliced carrots. Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 4 cups of summer squash squares and 1 cup of squash in 4 large chunks.
Add 1 can of drained corn and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 scallion, 1/2 hot pepper and 1 cup of onion.
Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.
Take out the 4 large squash chunks and puree them in a blender.
Return the puree to the pot and cook for 10 more minutes.
Add 1 cup of diced tomatoes.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of diced tomatoes and cook for another 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and let it sit for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Take the pot off the heat and let it sit for 10 minutes, so the stew thickens before serving.
